_about: Public-domain Jared Bell Waterbury (1799-1876), Presbyterian and Reformed minister of Hudson, Portsmouth, Boston and Brooklyn, for the Word Hoard: Advice to a Young Christian (1843), The Happy Christian (1839), A Book for the Sabbath (1840), The Voyage of Life (1852), The Sceptic Refuted (1853), The Child of the Covenant (1855), Taking up the Cross (1855), Sketches of Eloquent Preachers (1864) and his Memoir of John Scudder, missionary in India (1870). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 79 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

waterbury-advice-young-christian: Advice to a young Christian : On the importance of aiming at an elevated standard of piety (New York : [s.n.], 1843)

waterbury-sceptic-refuted: The sceptic refuted, and the Bible vindicated ([n.p.], 1853)
waterbury-taking-up-cross: Taking up the cross, or, Why should I not make a profession of religion? (Boston : Massachusetts Sabbath School Society, 1855)
waterbury-eloquent-preachers: Sketches of eloquent preachers (New York : The American Tract Society, 1864)
waterbury-memoir-scudder: Memoir of the Rev. John Scudder, M.D., thirty-six years missionary in India (New York : Harper, 1870)
